architecture.blend: max(validation AUC-0.5,0) weights; equal if both zero
architecture.line_transform: logit shift alpha=0.90 using weighted d7/d15/d30 prior hits, line=0.5

baselines.A: prior resolved population hit rate before slate
baselines.B: player prior rate shrunk with 8 pseudo-games at prior population rate

eligibility: official MLB dated active roster; non-pitcher position types; actual participation never admits a row

evidence_thresholds.moderate: point improvement over both; CI may include zero; ordering directional
evidence_thresholds.strong: point improvement over both baselines and clustered 95% CI above zero, monotonic ordering, ECE<=0.03
evidence_thresholds.weak: fails point improvement over either baseline or material calibration/order failure

initial_training: 2025-04-01 through 2025-09-28 resolved PA>0 active-roster rows; 2025 March is burn-in history only
outcome_rule: resolve only official completed game roster rows with PA>0; DNP and zero-PA remain explicit ungraded
snapshot_policy: 09:00 America/New_York date-level official active-roster state; same feature state for all games/doubleheaders that date
source_normalization: collapse only exact duplicate player records within one dated team roster; conflicting or cross-team player-game identities are fatal
unavailable_pitcher_bvp_policy: explicit NaN then fit-only median imputation plus missingness flags
walk_forward: rolling 540-day window; opening fit and Monday 09:00 ET refits; chronological 80/20 train/validation inside each fit
